title: Diff the fleet across sources
hints: Turn each input into a set of normalised serials first: {s.strip().upper() for s in source if s.strip()}.
With sets m and i: only_mdm is m - i, only_inventory is i - m, both is m & i.
neither is purchased minus (m | i); when purchased is None use an empty set. Wrap every result in sorted() to get a list.
